title: Education disruption and temporary learning capacity
currentCondition: Education disruption creates immediate and long-term child protection, teacher recovery, and learning-continuity concerns.
requiredCapacity: Temporary learning support, psychosocial support basics, safeguarding, teacher recovery, and youth civic capacity.
gapHypothesis: Current conditions suggest a need for temporary learning support, psychosocial support, safeguarding, teacher recovery, and youth civic capacity. This is a capacity hypothesis requiring human review.
caveats: No direct unsupervised contact with minors.
Learning plans require safeguarding review and partner mediation.

title: WASH and disease-prevention preparedness
currentCondition: WASH constraints remain connected to water, sanitation, fuel, waste, and disease-prevention risks.
requiredCapacity: Disease-prevention learning, safe-water awareness, community communication, rumor prevention, and coordinated referral pathways.
gapHypothesis: Current WASH constraints suggest a need for disease-prevention learning, community communication, safe-water awareness, and coordinated referral pathways. This pathway does not provide medical advice.
caveats: Public-health pathways link to official guidance and do not provide medical advice.
Field-facing action must go through reviewed partners.

title: Maternal health and dignity support
currentCondition: Protection needs intersect with maternal health, reproductive health, dignity, psychosocial stress, and referral awareness.
requiredCapacity: Maternal health support, dignity-centered protection, safeguarding, referral awareness, and accountable service pathways.
gapHypothesis: Conditions suggest a need for maternal health support, dignity-centered protection, referral awareness, and accountable service pathways.
caveats: Referral and protection pathways require qualified partner review.

title: Youth leadership and social cohesion capacity
currentCondition: Long-term recovery will require civic capacity, trauma awareness, dialogue skills, and non-extractive youth leadership pathways.
requiredCapacity: Conflict transformation, emotional intelligence, cultural intelligence, nonviolence, dialogue facilitation, and civic leadership.
gapHypothesis: Long-term recovery requires youth leadership pathways that build civic capacity, dialogue skills, trauma awareness, and practical peacebuilding.
caveats: Youth programming must be partner-mediated and safeguarding-reviewed.
Dialogue is not a substitute for justice, protection, or local leadership.

title: Trust evidence and responsible giving capacity
currentCondition: People who want to support need a disciplined way to read sources, organization evidence, caveats, sanctions risk, and action-routing policies.
requiredCapacity: Source verification, aid accountability, transparency review, sanctions awareness, and responsible donation routing.
gapHypothesis: People who want to support need better capacity to distinguish verified sources, transparent organizations, and responsible action pathways.
caveats: Evidence fields are not ratings or endorsements.
Support routing requires current compliance and human review.
